title: EXPERIMENTAL: A SECTION OF SWITCHES
why: His order after playing: an experimental menu inside Settings where he can turn the new features on and off. Settings has a new last section, EXPERIMENTAL, with its own chip and a lead row, NEW SINCE V26.54, with an ALL ON button. Every new feature gets one row, ON by default; OFF plays that part of the game the way v26.54 did. A switch is read when the raid starts and is held for the whole raid, so nothing flips under a live raid, and in a party the host switches rule for both windows. This first build brings the section and its first switch, RUN GOALS: off, a raid makes no goals and pays no chips.
now: Settings has an EXPERIMENTAL section of switches, starting with RUN GOALS.
